Alice,

Thanks — I got the draft and Order Form. Looping in Marissa (contracts) and Jonas (legal intake) to run a quick gap analysis and flag anything that needs priority attention.

For intake we typically need the following to avoid back-and-forth:
- Full legal entity name and EIN (for contracting signature page)
- Billing contact (name/email/phone) and payment terms exceptions if any
- Primary technical contact for implementation and an escalation contact for SLOs
- Confirmation of data residency preference and whether Zephyr will require a private deployment or dedicated environment
- Copy of most recent SOC 2 type II or link to secure evidence

Initial asks from our side (so you can prepare what to upload):
- If you can provide the SOC 2 report and the proposed language for Exhibit A (data processing/retention) that saves us time.
- Indicate which clauses in the attached MSA Zephyr expects to negotiate (e.g., indemnity, liability cap, audit rights).

Timeline suggestion: well do a first-pass internal gap summary by EOD tomorrow, and aim to return a redline or comment matrix by end of day Friday (11/06). If Zephyr needs faster turnaround, tell us which sections to prioritize.

Ill attach a simple redline matrix template for your convenience.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — initial gap notes (internal)

Internal quick notes (first-pass, not exhaustive):

High-level risk & flags:
- Indemnity: MSA currently has mutual indemnity but lacks a clear cap carve-out for IP claims. Suggest flag for escalation to legal policy.
- Liability cap: Zephyr has requested carrier/insurance language that may attempt to push cap above 12-months revenue; our standard is 12 months or $1M.
- Data processing / Exhibit A: Retention window is broader than our template (60 days vs our 30 days). Also missing subprocessors section and standard deletion confirmation.
- Audit rights: Contract requests broad audit rights without a scoped process or frequency limits; propose adding 90-days notice and defined scope.
- SLA and credits: Exhibit C has a 99.7% uptime target with ambiguous credit calculation; ops should confirm feasibility with infra team.

Owners / next steps:
- Marissa: draft marked redline for commercial clauses (liability/indemnity/cap/termination).
- Jonas: review DPA/Exhibit A and propose template language for subprocessors and retention.
- Kimberly: coordinate evidence request (SOC 2 link) and prepare standard security questionnaire (we use the lightweight security deck first).
- Chloe: coordinate timeline and external ask back to Zephyr.

Estimated internal ETA: marked redline + comment matrix by Fri 11/06 EOD. If ops raises concern on SLA feasibility, we might need to push the customer timeline by 48 hours.

-Marissa
